label: Reverb
terms_note: Reverb seller account (musical instruments / gear only); personal access token generated by the seller (OAuth for apps); sandbox at sandbox.reverb.com; rate limits not on the page read; Reverb selling fee applies.

discovery.auth: token (personal access token from the seller's Reverb settings, `X-Auth-Token` / bearer; OAuth for third-party apps)
sdks: official client libraries for Ruby, JavaScript and PHP (API page)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **high** — official developer documentation opened by the auditor.
auth: 1. Seller: Settings › API & Integrations → generate a personal access token with the needed scopes (read/write listings, read/write orders).
2. Apps: OAuth authorisation on behalf of sellers.
3. Unauthenticated calls return 401 with an embedded authentication link (HATEOAS).

endpoints.purpose: create / update a listing (title, make, model, condition, price, inventory, photos, shipping)
mark shipped with provider + tracking number

reference.limits: Not published on the page read; use ETag / 304 caching. - Seller terms + API terms (page 404 today); category limited to music gear. - Follow hypermedia links; do not construct URLs.
mcp_sdk: SDK: official client libraries for Ruby, JavaScript and PHP (API page)

fields.name: token
fields.help: Reverb Personal Access Token (My Profile > API & Integrations > Generate New Token) with scopes public, read_listings, write_listings, read_orders, write_orders; personal tokens do not expire. Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.help: Currency of your listing prices, e.g. USD; required when update_listing sends a price.

adapter.terms: Reverb API (hal+json, Accept-Version 3.0). Reverb may answer 429 to high request volumes; ask integrations@reverb.com for higher limits.

update_listing.note: PUT /api/listings/{listing_id} with the create parameters you want to change (title, description, price {amount, currency}, inventory). Live listings change immediately. `listing_id` is the Reverb listing id (find it by SKU with GET /api/my/listings?sku=…&state=all).

set_inventory.note: PUT /api/listings/{listing_id} {has_inventory: true, inventory} sets the stock of a listing that tracks inventory; `listing_id` is required (Reverb listings are addressed by id). With inventory 0 a listing shows as a draft until stock is added.

end_listing.note: PUT /api/my/listings/{id}/state/end {reason: not_sold} transitions a live listing to ended (the reverb_sale reason, which bills a selling fee for an in-person sale, is not used).

list_orders.note: GET /api/my/orders/selling/{all|unpaid|awaiting_shipment}: `status` selects that list (default all); since = updated_start_date (ISO-8601). Rows carry order_number, status (unpaid|payment_pending|pending_review|blocked|paid|shipped|picked_up|received|refunded|cancelled), total {amount, currency}; addresses and links in raw. `page` follows Reverb's page numbering.

mark_shipped.note: POST /api/my/orders/selling/{order_number}/ship {provider, tracking_number, send_notification: true} marks the order shipped and e-mails the buyer. `carrier` must be a provider from GET /api/shipping/providers (e.g. USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL).

not_offered.create_listing: POST /api/listings needs categories[{uuid}] and condition {uuid} from the Reverb taxonomies (plus make/model and shipping profile or rates) before a draft can be published; the vocabulary has no category or condition.

evidence: host api.reverb.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
